design_detail: tax on the whole wealth of individuals incl. deposits, securities, shares, gold; progressive rate suggested for property
quote_original: Sicer pa se v ZSSS zavzemamo za sistem, ki bi obdavčil celotno premoženje posameznika.
quote_en: ZSSS advocates a system that would tax the whole wealth of the individual.
source_title: Stališča ZSSS na Predlog izhodišč za obdavčitev premoženja (letter to the Ministry of Finance)
grading_note: Organisation position in a formal consultation reply: a tax on all wealth including financial assets, not only property; no rate given.

design_detail: tax on the whole wealth of individuals
quote_original: Sicer pa se v ZSSS zavzemamo za sistem, ki bi obdavčil celotno premoženje posameznika.
quote_en: ZSSS advocates a system that would tax the whole wealth of the individual.
source_title: Stališča ZSSS na Predlog izhodišč za obdavčitev premoženja (letter to the Ministry of Finance)
grading_note: The letter is signed by the ZSSS president on the organisation's behalf; B because no rate or threshold is given.

design_detail: European 'Tax the Rich' citizens' initiative (levy on great wealth)
quote_original: Socialni demokrati so danes pozvali k podpisu vseevropske pobude "Tax the rich" oziroma "Obdavčimo najbogatejše".
quote_en: The Social Democrats today called on people to sign the pan-European initiative "Tax the Rich".
source_title: SD pozvala k podpisu vseevropske pobude "Obdavčimo najbogatejše"
grading_note: Party campaigns for the ECI "Taxing great wealth to finance the ecological and social transition" (a levy on the richest by wealth); the article gives no rate.

quote_original: Socialni demokrati danes v Kopru predstavljamo pobudo za obdavčitev najbogatejših, ki so v času številnih kriz pridobili še več premoženja
quote_en: Today in Koper the Social Democrats present the initiative to tax the richest, who gained even more wealth during the many crises.
source_title: SD pozvala k podpisu vseevropske pobude "Obdavčimo najbogatejše"
grading_note: His own words presenting the ECI to tax the richest; no rate or design given.

design_detail: European wealth tax; 'Tax the Rich' ECI; est. EUR 565 million a year for Slovenia
quote_original: Stranka Vesna – zelena stranka, članica Evropske zelene stranke, odločno podpira evropsko državljansko pobudo "Tax The Rich" za obdavčitev najpremožnejših
quote_en: The Vesna Green Party, a member of the European Green Party, strongly supports the European citizens' initiative 'Tax The Rich' to tax the wealthiest.
source_title: Stranka Vesna odločno podpira obdavčitev najpremožnejših
grading_note: Party press release endorsing the ECI; the same report says its EP manifesto includes a "European wealth tax". B because this is the news report of the release, not the manifesto text.

design_detail: progressive tax on wealth above $100 million (Zucman 2% scenario and higher); Slovenia est. over EUR 0.5bn a year
quote_original: V praksi bi bilo pravično uvesti progresivno davčno stopnjo, z nižjimi davčnimi stopnjami za premoženje med 100 milijoni in milijardo dolarjev ter višjimi stopnjami za premoženje, ki presega milijardo dolarjev.
quote_en: In practice it would be fair to introduce a progressive rate, lower for wealth between $100 million and $1 billion and higher above $1 billion.
source_title: Obdavčimo najbogatejše: koliko prihodkov bi lahko v državne blagajne prinesla obdavčitev bogatašev?
grading_note: Own four-scenario analysis of a wealth tax on holdings above $100m with a recommendation for progressive rates; date from the page (21 January 2025).

design_detail: higher taxation of the wealth of the richest, to fund lower taxes on labour
quote_original: Izpad prihodkov bi nadomestili z višjo obdavčitvijo premoženja najbogatejših in z zapiranjem vrzeli
quote_en: The lost revenue would be replaced by higher taxation of the wealth of the richest and by closing loopholes.
source_title: Kaj politične stranke pravijo o obremenitvi plač in kapitala?
grading_note: The party's own written answer to RTV SLO's 2026 election questionnaire; names a tax on the wealth of the richest, no rate or threshold.

design_detail: "premoženjski davek" justified by 20,000 people holding over half of all wealth
quote_original: Edino pošten in solidaren premoženjski davek lahko naglasi to neenakost.
quote_en: Only an honest and solidary wealth tax can address this inequality.
grading_note: Said on a TV debate about the coalition agreement, arguing from the concentration of net wealth; the design (wealth or property) was not fixed, so B.

design_detail: "progressive taxation of property" from the 2022 coalition agreement; 80 percent of residents would pay nothing
quote_original: progresivna obdavčitev premoženja pomeni to, da 80 odstotkov prebivalcev in prebivalk ne bo obdavčenih čisto nič
quote_en: progressive taxation of property means that 80 percent of residents will not be taxed at all
source_title: Kako je Robert Golob poslancem razložil progresivno obdavčitev premoženja
grading_note: Defends the coalition agreement's 'progressive taxation of property' in his investiture speech; the agreement is unclear whether it covers all wealth or real estate only, so C.

design_detail: progressive tax on the whole net wealth of millionaires incl. real estate, shares and securities
quote_original: Pripravili bomo davek na celotno neto premoženje najpremožnejših, s katerim bomo progresivno obdavčili celotno neto premoženje milijonarjev in milijonark, vključno z nepremičninami, delnicami in vrednostnimi papirji.
quote_en: We will prepare a tax on the total net wealth of the wealthiest, progressively taxing the total net wealth of millionaires, including real estate, shares and securities.
grading_note: Election programme measure naming a progressive net wealth tax on millionaires. The 2022 programme also lists a real-estate tax and a tax on empty dwellings, which are not counted. The programme PDF carries no date; March 2022 from its upload path.

design_detail: "Tisočinka": about 0.1% on all wealth of individuals, 0.3% of legal entities; exemption up to EUR 100,000
quote_original: Predlog predvideva minimalno obdavčitev celotnega premoženja – približno 0,1 odstotka za fizične osebe in 0,3 odstotka za pravne osebe.
quote_en: The proposal provides a minimal tax on total wealth - about 0.1 percent for natural persons and 0.3 percent for legal entities.
source_title: O nepremičninskem davku: "Majhen davek na veliko premoženje je vedno bolj pravičen kot velik davek na delo"
grading_note: The association's own model, described by its president with rate and exemption; it has been put to politicians (SD adopted it in its 2022 programme, per N1).

design_detail: "Tisočinka": about 0.1% on all wealth of individuals, 0.3% of legal entities; exemption up to EUR 100,000
quote_original: Predlog predvideva minimalno obdavčitev celotnega premoženja – približno 0,1 odstotka za fizične osebe in 0,3 odstotka za pravne osebe.
quote_en: The proposal provides a minimal tax on total wealth - about 0.1 percent for natural persons and 0.3 percent for legal entities.
source_title: O nepremičninskem davku: "Majhen davek na veliko premoženje je vedno bolj pravičen kot velik davek na delo"
grading_note: Explains and defends the model with rates and an exemption; the quoted sentence is in the article, the explanation in his words ("pojasnjuje Novak").

design_detail: progressive tax on all wealth, not only real estate; SD programme took up the 0.1-0.3% Tisočinka idea
quote_original: V SD vztrajajo pri ideji progresivnega davka na premoženje – in prepričanju, da je treba povečati davčni izplen.
quote_en: SD insists on the idea of a progressive wealth tax and on the conviction that tax revenue must be raised.
source_title: Davek na premoženje na stranskem tiru, upanje v koaliciji še tli
grading_note: Journalist's report of SD's position, supported in the same article by SD's answers; the design (all wealth, not only property) is stated there. B because it is narration.
